brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted a raid on Tubas city overnight, Shehab Wire reported. The operation represents the latest military incursion into the West Bank municipality, where Israeli forces have intensified operations in recent months.

The raid occurred as tensions remain elevated across the occupied Palestinian territories. Tubas, located in the northern West Bank, has been a frequent target of Israeli military operations. No immediate reports detailed casualties or arrests resulting from the overnight incursion.
